prerequisites: Node.js 16 and npm. The README says that the project must use Node 16, and the Docker images use Node 16.

steps.title: Install the dependencies
steps.text: The install also downloads the Cypress app for the browser tests. If that download fails, see the Troubleshooting section of the README.

steps.title: Set the API URL (optional)
steps.text: `npm run dev` reads `.env.development`, so the map calls the Greenstand dev query API at `https://dev-k8s.treetracker.org/query` (`NEXT_PUBLIC_API`). To use a local query API instead, put its URL in `.env.local`. For example, treetracker-query-api listens on port 3006 by default:

steps.title: Run the tests
steps.text: These are the Jest unit tests and the lint that CI runs. At this commit, 53 tests pass and 2 are skipped, and the lint reports warnings only. CI also runs the Cypress tests (`npm run cypress:run:component` and `npm run cypress:run:fast`).

steps.title: Start the app
steps.text: Open http://localhost:3000. To work without an API, use mock data instead: `npm run dev:mock`.
